title: Grant AI: Discovery, Fit Scoring & Narrative Drafting
problem: Grant discovery, eligibility parsing, and narrative drafting are slow and inconsistent; submissions miss rubric-aligned details.
approach: Crawler/API ingestion of grant sources → normalized index
Eligibility + fit scoring (topic, geography, budget, timeline)
Section-aware narrative drafting aligned to reviewer rubric
Submission checklist + artifact pack + status tracker
solution: End-to-end workflow to surface high-fit grants, draft rubric-aligned narratives, and track submission readiness.

seo.description: Grant AI agent: discover, score, and draft grants to the rubric with a submission-ready checklist.
